# One Halloween Night (unofficial fan guide)

> One Halloween Night is a free, realistic first-person home-invasion horror game for Windows, made in Unity by the solo developer ollienoseworthy and released on itch.io in October 2025. You play a 14-year-old left home alone on Halloween night to hand out candy. About 25 minutes long, two endings. Rated 4.2/5 from 118 ratings on itch.io (checked 2026-10-12).

This site is an unofficial fan guide, not affiliated with the developer or itch.io. Official page: https://ollienoseworthy.itch.io/one-halloween-night

## Guides

- [Home](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/): overview, quick facts, download links
- [Walkthrough](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/walkthrough): step-by-step guide to the whole night
- [Endings](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/endings): both endings (Hide = rescued, Escape the house = caught) and how to see both
- [Download](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/download): Windows install steps; availability on Steam, Mac, PS5, mobile, browser
- [How to play](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/gameplay): controls, length, tips
- [Games like One Halloween Night](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/games-like-one-halloween-night): 7 similar PC horror games
- [Videos](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/videos): full playthroughs with ending timestamps
- [Review](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/reviews): verdict and verbatim player comments
- [FAQ](https://www.onehalloweennight.net/faq)

## Key facts

- Price: free
- Platform: Windows only (no Steam, Mac, Linux, console, mobile or browser version as of 2026-10-12)
- Download: "One Halloween Night 1.2.zip", 669 MB; extract and run the .exe
- Controls: WASD move, mouse look, left click interact/advance dialogue, right click throw/drop
- Length: about 25 minutes (developer)
- Endings: 2, decided by the final choice "Escape the house or hide?"
